• Desktop mode opens the official ChatGP:
• Desktop mode opens the official ChatGPT app with separate data and a backend. Requires the new ChatGPT with Chat, Work, and Codex; ChatGPT Classic is not supported.
• This experimental feature uses internal ChatGPT mechanisms and may need compatibility updates.
• After signing in, quota appears automatically from the same Desktop session and refreshes every 5 minutes while it is running. No separate Codex sign-in is needed.
• Existing profiles need one new Desktop sign-in; their previous browser data is kept.
• Closing the manager keeps the menu bar available.
• ChatGPT/Codex may ask you to sign in again when sessions expire.
• Profile data belongs to the current macOS user; it is not a separately encrypted vault.
• Deleting a profile removes local data only, not the service account.
